name: Albion
source:
Albion is a really intelligent and dedicated alchemist. He is often so concerned about his work that he forgets to eat, sleep and even pay attention to the ones around him. Although he looks serious and distant Albion is a very direct and honest person.

[From [url=https://lyria-ghostkitty.itch.io/my-path]itch.io]
